prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Newlyweds aged 31 and 35 exchange a quiet affectionate glance at a small outdoor wedding dinner, seated beside each other at a wooden table with plain ceramic plates, linen napkins, seasonal flowers, and a few candles. Four adult guests converse behind them. Use considered framing, warm early-evening light, and authentic interaction rather than a staged toast. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.
review: Accepted: newlyweds at an outdoor dinner, affectionate interaction, credible faces and anatomy, background guests secondary, central couple safe for 4:3 crop.
